steps.text: Before making a coffee with the espresso machine make sure that your portafilter & basket are both clean and dry.
steps.label: dry portafilter

steps.text: Dose your ground coffee into the portafilter.
steps.label: dose ground coffee

steps.text: Using a coffee tamper, tamp your coffee. Then apply a light amount of pressure to compact your coffee.
steps.label: tamp the coffee

steps.text: Put the portafilter back into the machine.
steps.label: lock in portafilter

steps.text: Add boiling water to the espresso
steps.label: add hot water
